<a id="page-triggers"></a>
# Triggers

A reaction (`"actions": [{"trigger": {...}, "actions": [...]}]` on a node) starts on its trigger. In the chain,
`${result}` first holds the trigger's event (where a click landed, an input's new value). Screen triggers (`load`,
`valueChanged`, `timer`, `keyDown`...) are set on the canvas.

## Trigger types

### On a node: pointer

| type | When |
|---|---|
| <a id="trigger-click"></a>`click` | A tap (a click with a mouse). `${result}` holds where it landed (`x`, `y` in the node, `globalX`, `globalY`) and the modifier keys held (`meta`, `shift`, `alt`). |
| <a id="trigger-doubleTap"></a>`doubleTap` | Two taps in quick succession. A node with double tap reactions waits out the double tap timeout before its single taps run. |
| <a id="trigger-longPress"></a>`longPress` | A long press. |
| <a id="trigger-hold"></a>`hold` | A press held for `Trigger.holdMs`; letting go early cancels it. |
| <a id="trigger-secondaryClick"></a>`secondaryClick` | A right click, or a two-finger tap on a trackpad (`${result.x}`, `${result.y}`: where, on screen). |
| <a id="trigger-pointerDown"></a>`pointerDown` | A pointer went down on the node. |
| <a id="trigger-pointerUp"></a>`pointerUp` | A pointer went up (or was canceled) on the node. |
| <a id="trigger-hover"></a>`hover` | The mouse cursor moved over the node (fires when it enters, too). |
| <a id="trigger-cursorEnter"></a>`cursorEnter` | The mouse cursor entered the node (once). |
| <a id="trigger-cursorExit"></a>`cursorExit` | The mouse cursor left the node (once). |
| <a id="trigger-swipeLeft"></a>`swipeLeft` | A swipe (a fling) to the left, right, up or down. |
| <a id="trigger-swipeRight"></a>`swipeRight` |  |
| <a id="trigger-swipeUp"></a>`swipeUp` |  |
| <a id="trigger-swipeDown"></a>`swipeDown` |  |
| <a id="trigger-drag"></a>`drag` | The node is dragged (every move); `dragEnd` when it's let go. |
| <a id="trigger-dragEnd"></a>`dragEnd` |  |
| <a id="trigger-wheel"></a>`wheel` | Wheel or trackpad scroll over the node; a pinch on it. |
| <a id="trigger-pinch"></a>`pinch` |  |

### On an input

| type | When |
|---|---|
| <a id="trigger-changed"></a>`changed` | An input's value changed (typed text, a toggled checkbox, a slider step, a picked item). `${result}` is the new value (a text field's: its text, word and selection). |
| <a id="trigger-changeEnd"></a>`changeEnd` | A slider was let go, with its final value. |
| <a id="trigger-submitted"></a>`submitted` | A text field was submitted from the keyboard. |
| <a id="trigger-editingComplete"></a>`editingComplete` | A text field lost focus after editing. |
| <a id="trigger-focusGained"></a>`focusGained` | A text field gained or lost focus. |
| <a id="trigger-focusLost"></a>`focusLost` |  |

### On a screen (fire while it shows, wherever they are set)

| type | When |
|---|---|
| <a id="trigger-load"></a>`load` | A screen appeared (set on its canvas). |
| <a id="trigger-backPressed"></a>`backPressed` | On a screen (its canvas): the user tried to leave it (the system or browser back button, a back gesture, Escape on a dialog) while the canvas's `blockBack` holds (`props.blockBack`, usually bound: `${= dirty}`). The screen stays and these actions run instead, e.g. a "Discard changes?" confirm that leaves with a navigate pop, which the block doesn't stop. While `blockBack` is false, back leaves as usual and this doesn't fire. |
| <a id="trigger-valueChanged"></a>`valueChanged` | Variable `Trigger.variable` changed while the screen shows. |
| <a id="trigger-timer"></a>`timer` | Every `Trigger.intervalMs` while the screen shows (`Timer.periodic`) and `Trigger.when` holds; `${result.tick}` counts. |
| <a id="trigger-frame"></a>`frame` | Every frame while the node is on stage and `Trigger.when` holds (a `Ticker`): `${result.dt}` (ms since the tick this chain last got), `${result.elapsed}` (ms since it started), `${result.frame}`. A frame that comes while the chain still runs is skipped; its time goes to the next `dt`. A design canvas never ticks. |
| <a id="trigger-keyDown"></a>`keyDown` | A key went down (or up) while the screen shows; `Trigger.key` limits it to one key or combination, `Trigger.when` to while a formula holds. `${result.key}`, `${result.shift}`, `${result.alt}`, `${result.meta}`. |
| <a id="trigger-keyUp"></a>`keyUp` |  |
| <a id="trigger-actionError"></a>`actionError` | On the current canvas: a failed action chain or cloud subscription. `${result.error}` is `{type, message, action, nodeId}` (no stack or raw service objects). A failure in this reaction reports to the host without recursively firing another actionError reaction. |

### Scrolling, viewport, images, drag and drop, lists

| type | When |
|---|---|
| <a id="trigger-imageLoading"></a>`imageLoading` | A node's image fill started loading, became ready, or failed. `${result.url}` identifies the image and `${result.status}` is `loading`, `loaded`, or `error`. Cached images can report loaded immediately without a loading event. |
| <a id="trigger-imageLoaded"></a>`imageLoaded` |  |
| <a id="trigger-imageError"></a>`imageError` |  |
| <a id="trigger-scroll"></a>`scroll` | The node (a scrolling row, column or canvas) scrolled (`${result.offset}`, `${result.max}`, `${result.fraction}`), or came near its end (load the next page). |
| <a id="trigger-scrollEnd"></a>`scrollEnd` |  |
| <a id="trigger-enterViewport"></a>`enterViewport` | At least `Trigger.visibleFraction` of the node became visible (and stayed so for `Trigger.visibleMs`), or it fell below that after being visible. With `Trigger.onceKey` (`${item.id}`), an impression: once per item per app session. |
| <a id="trigger-exitViewport"></a>`exitViewport` |  |
| <a id="trigger-dragStart"></a>`dragStart` | Drag and drop: on a draggable (start, cancel, completed) and on a drop target (drop, enter, exit, hover, rejected; full: `dropFull`). `${result}` and `${drag}` hold the drag. A list with a `reorder` fires `dragStart` when a row is picked up and `dragCompleted` when it is let go (moved or not), with `${result.index}` and `${result.item}`: a list can change while a row is lifted (fold its rows into tiles). On a node with a `drag` reaction (and no drag and drop), `dragStart` is the start of that one-finger drag, where the finger went down (`${drag.x}`, `${drag.y}`): begin a stroke there rather than on `pointerDown`, which fires for every finger of a pinch. |
| <a id="trigger-dragCancel"></a>`dragCancel` |  |
| <a id="trigger-dragCompleted"></a>`dragCompleted` |  |
| <a id="trigger-drop"></a>`drop` |  |
| <a id="trigger-dragEnter"></a>`dragEnter` |  |
| <a id="trigger-dragExit"></a>`dragExit` |  |
| <a id="trigger-dragHover"></a>`dragHover` |  |
| <a id="trigger-dropRejected"></a>`dropRejected` |  |
| <a id="trigger-dropFull"></a>`dropFull` | On a drop target that is full (its `fullIf` holds) when a drag of a group it accepts is let go on it: the drag springs back and these run, reading the drop as `drop` does; `${drag.full}` is true. |
| <a id="trigger-reorder"></a>`reorder` | A data list row was dragged to a new place by this node, its reorder handle (`${result.from}`, `${result.to}`). A list with a `reorder` fires it too, with `${result.item}`, `${result.fromList}`, `${result.toList}`. |
| <a id="trigger-refresh"></a>`refresh` | A list or grid was pulled past its start to refresh (its `pullToRefresh`, or its pagination's); its pagination reloads its first page too. A list with this reaction can always be pulled. |
| <a id="trigger-swipeAction"></a>`swipeAction` | A swipe action of a list item ran (the list's `swipeActions`): `${result.action}`, `${result.label}`, `${result.item}`, `${result.index}`. |
| <a id="trigger-rowTap"></a>`rowTap` | A table view's body row was tapped: `${result.row}` (the row's data), `${result.rowIndex}`, `${result.column}` (the tapped column's key), `${result.columnIndex}`. |
| <a id="trigger-event"></a>`event` | On a component call: the component fired its event `Trigger.event` (a `componentEvent` action inside its definition); `${result}` is the event's payload. Flutter: the callback passed to a widget's `onChanged`-style parameter. The handler runs in the caller's scope. |

## Trigger fields

A trigger is `{"type": "<type>", ...these}`, or just the type as a string (`"click"`).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | [TriggerType](values.md#enum-TriggerType) | `"click"` |  |  |
| `debounceMs` | int | `0` |  | Waits this long after the last trigger before running, so a burst (typing in a search field) runs once. 0 runs every time. |
| `variable` | String | `""` |  | `TriggerType.valueChanged`: the variable watched. |
| `intervalMs` | int | `1000` |  | Timer: ms between ticks (a number or an expression). |
| `key` | String | `""` |  | Key triggers: the key or combination (`KeyCombo`); empty: any key. |
| `when` | String | `""` |  | A formula; the reaction runs only while it's true (key triggers take the key only then; a timer or a frame ticker runs only then). Empty: always. |
| `holdMs` | int | `1200` |  | `TriggerType.hold`: how long the press is held. |
| `visibleFraction` | double | `0.15` |  | Viewport triggers: the visible share (0–1) that counts as in view. |
| `repeat` | bool | `false` |  | keyDown: also while the key repeats. |
| `visibleMs` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Viewport: how long it stays in view before firing (ms). |
| `onceKey` | String | `""` |  | Runs once per key (an expression, such as ${item.id}) per app session. |
| `event` | String | `""` |  | event: the key of the component event it handles (one of the component's widget.events). |
